subtitle: Robot with AI vision
p1: At an industrial system's heart, a Jetson Nano module increases its functionality. SELENE III is improved to be a full AI program with real-time object detection.
p2: SELENE III manages the installation's workflow, controlling the conveyor belts' speeds and guiding the robotic arm. SELENE III also includes a protection system that stops the installation and sends an alert message in the presence of a person if the installation is on.
i2: Notification of an emergency stop via Telegram bot
v1: SELENE III activating the robotic arm and slowing down the conveyor belt's speed
v2: SELENE II with color and shape-based detection in comparison
